verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a payment mode where crypto is converted and received in fiat: merchants accept stablecoin payments and get fiat in their account, with BVNK generating a live quote per payment and handling conversion and settlement ([bvnk-docs-9], [bvnk-docs-26], [bvnk-docs-33], [bvnk-docs-19]). Fiat balances can then be paid out to first-party or third-party bank accounts ([bvnk-docs-11], [bvnk-docs-24], [bvnk-docs-18]). Missing for 10: no documented automatic sweep from the fiat balance to a bank payout (payouts appear to be separate actions), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the settle-in-fiat flow.
